w2:textbox.label:
1. Select the frameModal option for the openPopup() method in the innermost frame. (“frame”, ‘parent’, “top”, frame ID)
2. Click the $p.openPopup() button inside the window.
3. Verify the popup's display scope based on the selected option.

The behavior based on the frameModal option value is as follows:
   “frame” : Displays as a modal popup inside the specified frame.
   “parent”: Displays as a modal popup inside the parent frame.
   “top”: Displays as a modal popup covering the entire screen.
   Frame ID: Displays as a modal popup inside the specified frame. (In the example, the frame ID is obtained via $p.getFrame().getParentFrame().getParentFrame().id.)
